text:
I'm sorry your replacement didn't make it either. The replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee from its delivery date, so if you're still within that window, you can claim one more replacement.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. Please note that the plant sent as this second replacement won't have a guarantee of its own.

If you'd like, a Plant Care Specialist can also give you free advice by chat or email on what may have gone wrong, so the next one has a better chance.
